from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import *
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from pyspark.sql.functions import month, hour

# Inicializa Spark
spark = SparkSession.builder.appName("Job_info_yellow_taxi").getOrCreate()

# Caminhos de entrada e saída no S3
input_path_data_01 = "s3://alsimoes/empresas/ifood/bronze/yellow_tripdata_2023-01.parquet"
input_path_data_02 = "s3://alsimoes/empresas/ifood/bronze/yellow_tripdata_2023-02.parquet"
input_path_data_03 = "s3://alsimoes/empresas/ifood/bronze/yellow_tripdata_2023-03.parquet"
input_path_data_04 = "s3://alsimoes/empresas/ifood/bronze/yellow_tripdata_2023-04.parquet"
input_path_data_05 = "s3://alsimoes/empresas/ifood/bronze/yellow_tripdata_2023-05.parquet"
output_path = "s3://alsimoes/empresas/ifood/silver/info_yellow_taxi.parquet"

# Leitura do Parquet
df01 = spark.read.parquet(input_path_data_01)
df02 = spark.read.parquet(input_path_data_02)
df03 = spark.read.parquet(input_path_data_03)
df04 = spark.read.parquet(input_path_data_04)
df05 = spark.read.parquet(input_path_data_05)

# Seleção das colunas
df01 = df01.select(
        "VendorID",
        "passenger_count",
        "total_amount",
        "tpep_pickup_datetime",
        "tpep_dropoff_datetime",
        month("tpep_pickup_datetime").alias("id_month"),
        hour("tpep_pickup_datetime").alias("id_hour"))
df02 = df02.select(
        "VendorID",
        "passenger_count",
        "total_amount",
        "tpep_pickup_datetime",
        "tpep_dropoff_datetime",
        month("tpep_pickup_datetime").alias("id_month"),
        hour("tpep_pickup_datetime").alias("id_hour"))
df03 = df03.select(
        "VendorID",
        "passenger_count",
        "total_amount",
        "tpep_pickup_datetime",
        "tpep_dropoff_datetime",
        month("tpep_pickup_datetime").alias("id_month"),
        hour("tpep_pickup_datetime").alias("id_hour"))
df04 = df04.select(
        "VendorID",
        "passenger_count",
        "total_amount",
        "tpep_pickup_datetime",
        "tpep_dropoff_datetime",
        month("tpep_pickup_datetime").alias("id_month"),
        hour("tpep_pickup_datetime").alias("id_hour"))
df05 = df05.select(
        "VendorID",
        "passenger_count",
        "total_amount",
        "tpep_pickup_datetime",
        "tpep_dropoff_datetime",
        month("tpep_pickup_datetime").alias("id_month"),
        hour("tpep_pickup_datetime").alias("id_hour"))

# União dos dataframes
df_info_yellow_taxi = df01.unionByName(df02).unionByName(df03).unionByName(df04).unionByName(df05)

# Escrita no S3 Silver
df_info_yellow_taxi.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(output_path)

print("informação de frota de táxi amarelo gerada com sucesso no caminho: " + output_path)
